Personal Home remains an orchestrating projection over owning domains rather than a Personal truth super-domain.

completion_gate: A valid zero-Campaign subject lands in a useful Personal Home; Personal Home projects only authorized Personal-owned or Personal-accessible resources from owning domains; Campaign-private material is never copied into Personal authority; Personal↔Campaign/Session switching performs fresh authorization and protected-partition replacement; stale/revoked recent-work or deep links fail closed without leaking protected existence; disabling Personal Home leaves owning screens/resources available; and desktop/mobile/keyboard/nonvisual paths make current context and switching semantics understandable.

What minimum Personal Home projection contract can compose Continue, Characters, Creative Library, Practice/Sandbox, Reference, Invitations, Waiting/Notifications, Campaigns, portability and account/entitlement entry points while leaving payload ownership with existing domains?

Which APW-I02 surfaces are currently implementable from existing authorized Stage A/APW-I01 projections, and which future-resource areas must remain explicit empty/disabled placeholders rather than fabricated data?
Does APW-I02 require durable Personal workspace metadata on the then-current migration baseline, and if so which established owner owns it and what is the actual next unused migration number?

How does Personal→Campaign/Session switching revalidate membership, contextual role/delegation, lifecycle, Character control, entitlements/packs, visibility and route existence before changing protected context?

How does Campaign/Session→Personal switching clear Campaign roles, hidden data, realtime subscriptions, caches, search results, recent links, notification counts and optional-assistance context that are not legal in Personal scope?
How are recent-work and deep-link candidates reauthorized before display and again before entry so revoked Campaign history does not leak through labels, counts or errors?
How are Personal-owned resources distinguished from Personal-accessible references such as entitled content, Campaign-controlled Characters and Campaign links without ownership transfer?
What feature-disable/rollback behavior keeps owning screens and Personal resources reachable when the Personal Home projection is disabled?

Which deterministic cross-platform tests prove useful zero-Campaign Home, authority-safe switching, no hidden-data bleed, stale-link failure, contextual-role reset, accessibility/mobile parity and owning-screen fallback?
